summary: Social Spotlight Twitter Quick Links & YouTube Feed Enhancement - All features tested and verified. The new Twitter/X 'Follow on X' section displays 11 school cards at bottom of feed. YouTube feed now returns 20 videos from 5 schools (up from 7 videos from UCLA only). Backend APIs and frontend integration working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend /api/social-spotlight/feed returns videos from 5 schools (UCLA, Johns Hopkins, Georgia Tech, U of Texas, U of Florida)
Backend /api/social-spotlight/feed returns 20 total videos (up from 7 UCLA-only)
Backend /api/social-spotlight/social-links returns 11 schools with Twitter URLs
Social-links endpoint returns correct structure (program_id, university_name, twitter, logo_url, domain)
Twitter/X 'Follow on X' section visible at bottom of feed
Twitter cards display school logo, name, and @handle
Twitter cards are clickable links (target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer')
Twitter section hides when specific school filter is active
Twitter section reappears when 'All Schools' filter is selected
critical_code_review_comments: TwitterSection component well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes (twitter-section, twitter-link-{program_id})
Backend /api/social-spotlight/social-links endpoint correctly filters schools with Twitter URLs from knowledge base
Frontend correctly hides Twitter section when school filter is active (!selectedName && twitterSchools.length > 0)
Twitter cards have proper accessibility (external link with noopener noreferrer)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data from university_knowledge_base and YouTube API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Twitter Quick Links feature added to Social Spotlight. API endpoint /api/social-spotlight/social-links returns schools with Twitter URLs. TwitterSection component renders at bottom of feed when 'All Schools' is selected. YouTube feed now has content from 5 schools (UCLA: 7 videos, Johns Hopkins: 8 videos, Georgia Tech: 3 videos, U of Texas: 1 video, U of Florida: 1 video). Data-testids: twitter-section, twitter-link-{program_id}. 11 schools have Twitter links configured in knowledge base.
